relationships.evidence_quote: After MSU stimulation, the expressions of NLRP3, ASC, and Caspase-1 were upregulated. But these effects were significantly inhibited by GPS (Fig. 3a–c).

relationships.subject: gentiopicroside
relationships.evidence_quote: The results showed that GPS can downregulate the activity of caspase-1 (Fig. 3g).

relationships.subject: MSU crystals
relationships.evidence_quote: MSU crystals are first phagocytized by macrophages, and then promote the assembly and activation of NLRP3 inflammasome [8].

relationships.subject: gentiopicroside
relationships.evidence_quote: GPS decreased the expressions of TNF-α (Fig. 6a), IL-6 (Fig. 6b), and IL-1β (Fig. 6c).

relationships.subject: gentiopicroside
relationships.evidence_quote: GPS and colchicine both significantly attenuated MSU-induced neutrophil infiltration in paw tissue (Fig. 7b).

relationships.subject: Caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: As an effector, caspase-1 cleaves the pro-IL-1β and pro-IL-18 into IL-1β and IL-18, respectively [10].

key_findings: Gentiopicroside relieved MSU-induced hyperalgesia, swelling and neutrophil infiltration in gouty arthritis mice
GPS suppressed NLRP3, ASC and caspase-1 expression and caspase-1 activity in paw tissue and LPS-MSU RAW264.7 macrophages; serum TNF-α decreased but paw tissue TNF-α unaffected
